subject: Data division structure
notes: kb/Work PB1226: the REPORT SECTION is `REPORT SECTION. [ report-description-entry { constant-entry | report-group-description-entry } ... ] ...`. reportDescriptionEntry is `RD ... DOT (constantEntry | reportGroupEntry)*`; the constant entry shares constantEntryBody and DataBinder.BindConstantEntry with the data description entry and binds in source order (BindReportSectionEntries), so DISPLAY K prints 7 and K substitutes in VALUE and in PIC X(K). The brace group's one-or-more is 13.8.4's COBOL2708 at bind time (an RD with no report group entry; a constant alone does not satisfy it).
